plugins.name: job-application
plugins.description: Job posting review, tailored resume and cover letter, tracker, interview prep, and follow-ups.

plugins.name: jira-ops
plugins.description: Backlog grooming against a Definition of Ready, AI spend-increase governance, and sprint reports.

plugins.name: catch-me-up
plugins.description: Cross-app triage of what needs you across email, Slack, Jira, and more.

plugins.name: transcript-processor
plugins.description: Turns meeting transcripts into 1:1 and team notes, action items, and callouts.

plugins.name: architect-toolkit
plugins.description: Architecture decision records with weighted scoring and sensitivity analysis, an adversarial pre-mortem, and a Well-Architected style review of Terraform and CloudFormation with an HTML report.

plugins.name: saas-migration-planner
plugins.description: Plans SaaS migrations (identity provider, HRIS, Apple MDM) from an integration inventory: risk-scored dependencies, cutover waves around freezes and payroll boundaries, rollback plans, and an HTML roadmap.

plugins.name: mac-setup
plugins.description: Snapshots your Mac (Homebrew, App Store apps, dotfiles, macOS defaults, app settings) into a git-friendly folder with an idempotent bootstrap script, and re-syncs it on demand. Claude Code on a real Mac only.

plugins.name: career-interview
plugins.description: Interviews you one question at a time from your current resume and compiles a career.md: metric-backed accomplishments, calibrated skills, STAR+R stories, and a target-role profile. Type pause anytime to save progress. Works in Claude and ChatGPT.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: End-of-session retrospective that proposes CLAUDE.md, memory, or skill additions from your corrections, repeated workflows, and gotchas. Nothing is written without approval.

plugins.name: candidate-screen
plugins.description: Screens a stack of job applications against a posting: approve the requirements, tune the weights, get evidence-verified fit and learning-agility scores, catch fake and AI-gamed applications, and export a ranked report that retunes itself live and compares candidates side by side. Browser app in Claude Code, chat mode in Cowork.
